title: Task records attribute grounding-regeneration files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, host rule files) as work the task did
observation: gitTouchedFiles counts every non-merge commit by the git user inside the task window. A capture commit ('hunch: capture dec_...') regenerates the grounding block in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/hunch.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md and .windsurf/rules/hunch.md, so every task that recorded a decision now lists those five files, and any task open while another session captured does too. Only .hunch/.hunch-cache/.git segments are excluded. Effect: the RECENT TASKS ranking sees a co-change signal between unrelated tasks and the grounding files; hunch_why CLAUDE.md lists every capturing task. Observed 2026-09-16: all three records written since 1.38.0 (two public, one private) list the same five grounding files; commit a8f92cc shows the capture rewriting them.
evidence: private record of a research-only prompt lists the same five grounding files
src/core/taskTouched.ts EXCLUDED_SEGMENTS = {.hunch, .hunch-cache, .git} only; no subject filter for 'hunch: capture' / 'hunch: task' commits
